ACT_1 opens at 14.496 (VC-0005) and runs to 270.400; ACT_2 272.200 to 565.390 (VC-0059..VC-0114); ACT_3 567.190 to 1023.008 (VC-0115..VC-0185); ACT_4 1024.808 to 1515.853 (VC-0186..VC-0267); ENDING 1516.453 to 1595.171 (VC-0268..VC-0278). total_seconds 1595.164 over 278 chunks. _declared_values.not_yet_on_disk: `assets` and `captions` name the files the staging and caption steps will write (asset_manifest.v003.json, captions.final.v001.srt), the same naming EP80-EP83 declared. Neither exists yet, which is the state EP82 and EP83 were in when their filmconfigs were authored -- the config declares the contract and the later step fills it. 06_audio/narration_index.v001.json and remotion/public/katrina/narration.mp3 (1595.164 s) DO exist and were read for this file, as do the 173 reviewed plates in remotion/public/katrina/img (13 rejected plates are in img/rejected and are not referenced here).
_declared_values.figures_by_section: Authored 2026-08-28 from 03_script/script.en.v001.md and EP85_katrina_FACTS_LEDGER.v001.md. Counts are 17/17/17/17 across ACT_1..ACT_4, at the top of episode_spec's figure_beats_per_act [13,17]; HOOK 2 and ENDING 3; 73 cards in total. EVERY number on a card is a number the narration speaks -- 350, 14.2, 8.2, 14.4, 950, 50, 29, 4, 220, 41, 70, 40, 1.3, 3, 1118 -- and every `stat` `value` is numeric so nothing can render as NaN. No `stat` carries a `group` key (the FigureSpec union does not give `stat` one; only `numberticker` has it).
_declared_values.years_are_never_stats: StatCounter formats with toLocaleString('en-US'), so a year in a `stat` renders as '1,977'. Every date in this deck -- 29 August 2005, 1977, 1959, 1900 to 1956, 1979, 1967, 1968, 1968-1980, November 2009, 2 March 2012, 25 September 2012, and the six-flood list -- is a kinetic pair or a quote, never a number card.
_declared_values.ranges_are_never_stats: Every range the narration speaks is drawn as a kinetic pair or a comparison, never squeezed into one number card: the 12-to-12.5-foot as-built height and the 10-to-11-foot water that broke it (KT-503), the 8.2-to-9.5-foot canal level at London Avenue (drawn as compbars against the 14.4-foot design height, its low end only and labelled as the canal water), the 6 a.m. to 9 a.m. window (KT-503), and hours-against-days (KT-803). The 50-to-500-year recurrence interval (KT-707) is narrated and deliberately not drawn.
_declared_values.breach_count_names_its_source: KT-402 and episode_spec forbidden_claims forbid any single breach count stated as THE number. The ACT_1 comparison prints three counts with whose they are on the bar itself -- IPET 50 major breaches, IPET's own appendix 29 aggregated for repair, ASCE 4 that failed before overtopping -- and the card after it says four different numbers, none of them wrong. Team Louisiana's 'over 50' is narrated and not drawn, because 'over 50' is not a number a bar can carry honestly.
_declared_values.no_OP_section: episode_spec's section_vocabulary lists OP, but narration_index has no OP chunks -- the brand opening is an overlay on the HOOK, not a spoken section, and the script's OP block carries no copy. A card there would have no window to live in.
_declared_values.quarantine: Nothing on screen says a court found the levees or floodwalls negligently built: the ACT_4 cards say the case that reached trial was not about the floodwalls, that those were already immune and the plaintiffs did not contest it (KT-207), and the trial judge's quote is attributed to the failure to maintain the channel (KT-203). Nothing on screen leaves the negligence finding standing -- the affirmed/reversed card and the 'shielded by the DFE' card are both in ACT_4 (KT-301, KT-302, KT-304). Nothing on screen says the reversal means the Corps was careful; the card immediately before it is the statute's own 'whether or not the discretion involved be abused' (KT-303, KT-307). No card says the channel funnelled the surge -- the card says the funnel is a myth and the case was about erosion (KT-708, KT-107). No card resolves the IPET/ILIT disagreement; the card says two teams, the same ground, two mechanisms (KT-510). No card says the city flooded because the walls were overtopped -- two-thirds through breaches (KT-801) and 'not overtopped, below design height' (KT-501) are both drawn. The death figure is 1,118 in Louisiana with 135 missing as of August 2006, carrying its scope on the card (KT-1001, KT-1005); '1,833' and 'over 1,800' appear nowhere. No card mentions a bus, an evacuation or who should have moved whom (KT-1106). No card carries an organisation mark, a seal or a readable document.
_declared_values.act_4_selection: ACT_4 runs 491 seconds and carries the channel, the trial finding, the appeal, the reversal and the closing verdicts; 17 cards is the spec ceiling, so the Gaubert 'susceptible to policy analysis' test (KT-305), the court's acknowledgement of the plaintiffs' evidence (KT-306), the ILIT three causes and 'no one group had a monopoly on responsibility' (KT-904, KT-905), the 'performed as designed' irony line (KT-903), the self-referential culture finding (KT-908) and the ages of the dead (KT-1006, KT-1008) are carried by the narration rather than by a card.
